item.title: Bulletin updated at 23:20 HKT 06/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will be generally fine over southern China midweek this week to early next week. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China midweek next week, the weather will be cloudier with cool mornings over the region.

Date/Month: 07/12 (Wednesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly fine. Cool with cloudy periods in the morning. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 16 - 22 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
